from dataclasses import asdict
from pydantic.dataclasses import dataclass

@dataclass
class UserPreferencesDataclass:
    sms_notifications: bool
    emergency_contact_phone: str
    home_address: str
    do_not_disturb_hours: str

@router.get("/users/{user_id}/preferences")
async def get_user_preferences(
    user_id: int,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    pref = await db.get(UserPreference, user_id)
    if not pref:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Preferences not found")
    data = UserPreferencesDataclass(
        sms_notifications=pref.sms_notifications,
        emergency_contact_phone=pref.emergency_contact_phone,
        home_address=pref.home_address,
        do_not_disturb_hours=pref.do_not_disturb_hours
    )
    return asdict(data)
diagnosis: The preferences endpoint accepts user_id in the URL path and returns serialized dataclass fields without validating that user_id == current_user.id. Any authenticated user can inspect home addresses and emergency contact numbers belonging to other users.
